title: Capability knowledge manifest — knowledge.yaml
description:
REFERENCES ONLY, the sibling of objects.yaml. Where objects.yaml says which nouns to load, knowledge.yaml says which playbooks, heuristics, mental models, rules and decision frameworks apply.

The core/scoped split is the same and is enforced the same way: an artifact two capabilities reference must live in <kind>/core/, and validate.py errors if a capability-scoped one is referenced twice. MEDDICC referenced by four capabilities is core; a cold-email deliverability heuristic referenced by one is scoped to cold_email.

This file exists so that changing what expertise a capability applies is a one-file diff, and so a Layer 6 Playbook Suggestion has something addressable to point at.

  capabilities/<NN-subdomain>/<capability>/knowledge.yaml

terminology.description: Terminology area ids whose vocabulary this capability speaks.

primary_framework.description: The one framework an operator would reach for first here. Named separately because a capability listing five frameworks with no ordering has told a reader nothing.

refset.description: core = shared artifacts from <kind>/core/. scoped = artifacts belonging to this capability alone, in <kind>/<capability>/.
